This notebook checks the effect of the new >50 km coastal NA screen added to
`calc_inundation_exposure()`. Water supplies more than 50 km from the coast
(per `coast_distances.csv`, produced by `process_coastal_weights()`) now have
every inundation indicator column set to `NA`, matching the convention already
used in `calc_swi_exposure()` and `calc_storm_surge_exposure()`. Some water
supplies sit within a NOAA SLR raster tile's footprint (e.g. up a tidal
estuary) while still being more than 50 km by straight-line CUSP-shoreline
distance — this notebook regenerates a pre-screen version of the results and
compares it against the official (screened) output to identify exactly which
water supplies the new screen affects.

# Establish environment

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
source("setup.R")
mapviewOptions(fgb = FALSE)
```

# Load data

## Water supplies

```{r}
water_supplies <- get_wsd(rapid = TRUE)
```

## Unfiltered inundation exposure (regenerated without the coastal screen)

`calc_inundation_exposure()` does not persist a pre-screen version of its
results, so we regenerate one here: rebuild the same `ws_scenarios` input used
in `rapid_workflow.Rmd`, then call the function with a rigged
`coast_distances` table (every `coast_dist_m` replaced with a non-`NA`
placeholder) so the >50 km screen has nothing to NA out. This reruns the
raster extraction, so it takes a few minutes — same cost as the official chunk
in `rapid_workflow.Rmd`.

```{r}
inun_regions_path <- here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "buff_ws_inun_regions.gpkg")

stopifnot(
  "buff_ws_inun_regions.gpkg not found — run process_inundation_data() in rapid_data_processing.Rmd first" =
    file.exists(inun_regions_path)
)

ws_slr_scenarios <- sf::st_read(inun_regions_path, quiet = TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(proj_file), buffer_km == 4)

ws_all <- ws_slr_scenarios %>%
  select(-park_unit) %>%
  right_join(
    water_supplies %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(wsd_source_id, park_unit),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  )

coast_distances_path <- here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "coast_distances.csv")

stopifnot(
  "coast_distances.csv not found — run process_coastal_weights() first" =
    file.exists(coast_distances_path)
)

# Disable the >50 km screen by replacing NA coast_dist_m with a placeholder —
# the join/NA-out step in calc_inundation_exposure() only screens rows where
# coast_dist_m is NA.
coast_distances_unrestricted <- read_csv(coast_distances_path, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(coast_dist_m = if_else(is.na(coast_dist_m), 0, coast_dist_m))

coast_distances_unrestricted_path <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write_csv(coast_distances_unrestricted, coast_distances_unrestricted_path)

inundation_unfiltered <- calc_inundation_exposure(
  ws_scenarios               = ws_all,
  inundation_raster_data_dir = here("data", "rapid", "inputs", "coast_comp", "Extent_Rasters"),
  coast_distances             = coast_distances_unrestricted_path,
  save    = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

## Filtered inundation exposure (post-screen, official output)

```{r}
inun_files <- list.files(
  here("data", "rapid", "outputs"),
  pattern    = "^inundation_exposure_.*\\.csv$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

stopifnot(
  "No inundation_exposure_*.csv found in data/rapid/outputs — rerun the SLR inundation chunk in rapid_workflow.Rmd" =
    length(inun_files) > 0
)

inundation_filtered <- read_csv(inun_files[length(inun_files)], show_col_types = FALSE)
```

# Identify newly-NA'd water supplies

Flag water supplies (at the 4 km buffer) where any of the core indicator
columns was non-`NA` before the screen but is `NA` after it — these are the
sites the >50 km coastal screen actually changed.

```{r}
screen_cols <- c("raw_coverage_pct_ref", "raw_coverage_pct_proj",
                  "raw_cell_change", "raw_pct_point_change")

comparison <- inundation_unfiltered %>%
  filter(buffer_km == 4) %>%
  select(wsd_source_id, all_of(screen_cols)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_before"), all_of(screen_cols)) %>%
  inner_join(
    inundation_filtered %>%
      filter(buffer_km == 4) %>%
      select(wsd_source_id, all_of(screen_cols)) %>%
      rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_after"), all_of(screen_cols)),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  ) %>%
  mutate(newly_na = pmap_lgl(
    list(raw_coverage_pct_ref_before, raw_coverage_pct_ref_after,
         raw_coverage_pct_proj_before, raw_coverage_pct_proj_after,
         raw_cell_change_before, raw_cell_change_after,
         raw_pct_point_change_before, raw_pct_point_change_after),
    function(ref_b, ref_a, proj_b, proj_a, cell_b, cell_a, pct_b, pct_a) {
      (!is.na(ref_b)  && is.na(ref_a)) ||
      (!is.na(proj_b) && is.na(proj_a)) ||
      (!is.na(cell_b) && is.na(cell_a)) ||
      (!is.na(pct_b)  && is.na(pct_a))
    }
  ))

newly_na_ids <- comparison %>% filter(newly_na) %>% pull(wsd_source_id)

message(length(newly_na_ids), " water supplies were newly set to NA by the >50 km coastal screen.")
```

# Map

Base layer: all water supplies that were part of the coastal inundation
analysis before the screen (colored by pre-screen `raw_coverage_pct_proj`),
grey for water supplies never in the analysis at all (no SLR scenario
assigned). Circled in black: the subset newly set to `NA` by the >50 km screen.

```{r}
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("green", "yellow", "red"))

ws_joined <- water_supplies %>%
  left_join(
    inundation_unfiltered %>% select(-park_unit),
    by = "wsd_source_id"
  )

ws_in_analysis  <- ws_joined %>% filter(!is.na(raw_coverage_pct_proj))
ws_not_analyzed <- ws_joined %>% filter(is.na(raw_coverage_pct_proj))
ws_newly_na     <- ws_joined %>% filter(wsd_source_id %in% newly_na_ids)

m <- mapview(ws_not_analyzed,
             col.regions = "grey70",
             color       = "grey70",
             layer.name  = "Not in coastal analysis",
             popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
               sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_not_analyzed) %>%
                 select(wsd_source_id, park_name)
             )) +
  mapview(ws_in_analysis,
          zcol        = "raw_coverage_pct_proj",
          col.regions = pal,
          layer.name  = "Proj inundation coverage (%, pre-screen)",
          popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
            sf::st_drop_geometry(ws_in_analysis) %>%
              select(wsd_source_id, park_name,
                     raw_coverage_pct_ref, raw_coverage_pct_proj,
                     raw_cell_change, raw_pct_point_change)
          ))

if (nrow(ws_newly_na) > 0) {
  m <- m +
    mapview(ws_newly_na,
            col.regions = NA,
            color       = "black",
            lwd         = 3,
            cex         = 8,
            alpha.regions = 0,
            layer.name  = "Newly NA'd (>50 km coastal screen)",
            popup       = leafpop::popupTable(
              comparison %>%
                filter(wsd_source_id %in% newly_na_ids) %>%
                left_join(sf::st_drop_geometry(water_supplies) %>%
                            select(wsd_source_id, park_name),
                          by = "wsd_source_id")
            ))
}

m
```
